positions.name: CadenceStatedAndFormalized
positions.frame: Is the monthly Atlas rollback-rehearsal cadence one settled commitment expressed twice — once as a declarative sentence, once as a structured directive field — or does the shift in register mark a distinct act of formalization?
positions.why: src-1 states the cadence as a full declarative sentence ('run monthly from now on') and src-3 restates the identical fact compressed into a labeled metadata field ('**Cadence**: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals'). Both name the same future-directed, concrete recurring commitment and both carry authority-ranking directive force, but they differ in register — prose narrative versus structured field — raising the question of whether the field entry adds formal ratification beyond the prose announcement or simply repeats it in a different document convention. No tension resolved here, just two co-present renderings of the same commitment.
